description_en: Create and issue an external subordinate CA certificate using a CSR and API parameters
description_zh: 基于CSR和API参数创建并颁发外部子CA证书
kebab_example: aliyun cas create-external-ca-certificate --instance-id cas_deposit-cn-1234abcd --csr -----BEGIN_CERTIFICATE_REQUEST-----_MIIBczCCARgCAQAwgYoxFDASBgNVBAMMC2FsaXl1bi50ZXN0MQ0wCwYDVQQ_..._vbIgMQIhAKHDWD6/WAMbtezAt4bysJ/BZIDz1jPWuUR5GV4TJ/mS_-----END_CERTIFICATE_REQUEST----- --validity 10y --api-passthrough '{"Extensions":{"PathLenConstraint":0,"ExtendedKeyUsages":["serverAuth"]},"Subject":{"Organization":"Alibaba","Locality":"Hangzhou","State":"Zhejiang","OrganizationUnit":"Cloud_Security","Country":"CN","CommonName":"Testing_CA"}}' --tags Value=1 Key=database --resource-group-id test --cert-max-time 30 --api-version 2020-06-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateExternalCACertificate

parameters.help_en: The ID of the external subordinate CA instance
parameters.help_zh: 需要启用的外部子CA实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The certificate signing request (CSR). The CSR can contain information such as the SubjectDN and custom extensions for the CA certificate. The CA generates the SubjectKeyIdentifier, AuthorityKeyIdentifier, and CRLDistributionPoints extensions, ignoring any corresponding values in the CSR
parameters.help_zh: 证书签名请求。可包含CA证书的SubjectDN、CA证书自定义扩展项等。SubjectKeyIdentifier、AuthorityKeyIdentifier、CRLDistributionPoints证书扩展项由CA生成，CSR中的值会被忽略
parameters.name: csr

parameters.help_en:
The certificate validity period. You can specify this using either relative or absolute time.

Relative time: Supported units are year, month, and day.

y - year

m - month

d - day

Absolute time: Use GMT time in the `yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss'Z'` format.

To specify only the expiration time, use `$NotAfter`.

To specify both the start and expiration times, use `$NotBefore/$NotAfter`
parameters.help_zh:
证书有效期。支持使用相对时间和绝对时间。

相对时间：支持单位年、月、日。

年 - y
月 - m
日 - d

绝对时间：使用 GMT 时间。格式：`yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss'Z'`

指定结束时间 - `$NotAfter`
指定开始时间和结束时间 - `$NotBefore/$NotAfter`
parameters.name: validity

fields.help_zh: 所属国家。使用ISO 3166-1的二位国家代码
fields.name: country

fields.help_en: The organizational subdivision, such as a department, team, project group, or branch
fields.help_zh: 所属组织内部的子单位（部门、团队、项目组或分支机构）
fields.name: organization_unit

fields.help_en: The name of the CA certificate
fields.name: common_name

fields.help_en: The subject information for the CA certificate. If specified, this value overwrites the SubjectDN from the CSR
fields.help_zh: CA证书主体信息。该值存在时会覆盖CSR中的SubjectDN
fields.name: subject

fields.help_en: The certificate path length constraint. For an end-entity CA, set this parameter to 0. A value of 0 indicates the CA will issue end-entity certificates
fields.help_zh: 证书路径长度限制。EndEntity CA 该值必须传0，即当前CA证书用于颁发End Entity证书
fields.name: path_len_constraint

fields.help_en: Specifies the extensions for the CA certificate. If specified, these values override the corresponding extensions in the CSR or are added to the CA certificate
fields.help_zh: CA证书扩展。该值存在时会覆盖CSR中的扩展项值，或添加到CA证书扩展项中
fields.name: extensions

parameters.help_en: Specifies API parameters that override content from the CSR or add information to the CA certificate
parameters.help_zh: 通过API参数覆盖CSR内容或添加到CA证书中
parameters.name: api_passthrough

parameters.help_en: The tags to add to the certificate
parameters.name: tags

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_zh: 签发证书的最长时间由CA的certMaxTime指定
parameters.name: cert_max_time

Identifier.description_en: The unique identifier for the certificate
